exhibits.what: four round icons in a row, each over a short label
exhibits.message: Boards face four pressures at once
exhibits.how_drawn: four bright blue circles evenly spaced across the middle, each holding a white line icon, with two or three lines of white centred label under it on the dark blue gradient
exhibits.marks: nothing is marked: the four pressures carry equal weight and no figure is shown

exhibits.what: five board stages climbing left to right as a rising staircase of headings and notes, photos beneath
exhibits.message: The board's role has moved from complacent to catalyst over 20 years
exhibits.how_drawn: five eras set as a staircase rising to the right, each a dot on a thin curved line, a bold white heading and a few lines of notes with key phrases in bold; four rounded photographs in a row across the foot
exhibits.marks: the dot and curve that rise from era to era carry the sequence, and the bold phrases in each note carry the change; the photographs illustrate and carry no mark

exhibits.what: three columns of numbered items with photo bullets, joined by chevrons into platform, activities and levers
exhibits.message: Fifteen elements in three groups make an effective board
exhibits.how_drawn: three columns under bold white headings and thin rules, five rows each of a round photograph, a numbered blue disc and a short label, rows split by thin white lines; circled arrow heads sit between the column headings
exhibits.marks: numbered discs 1 to 15 key each element, and the circled arrows between headings read platform, then activities, then levers

exhibits.what: four large percentages stepping down the page, each over its survey statement
exhibits.message: Boards are strongest on setting strategy and weakest on reducing bias
exhibits.how_drawn: four large serif percentages in bright blue, each over three or four lines of white centred statement, stepping down from upper left to lower right across the page
exhibits.marks: the descent of the four figures down the page shows their order from 70% to 36%; no figure is boxed or coloured apart

exhibits.what: a plain list of topics beside a large photograph
exhibits.message: The boardroom agenda spans fourteen topics
exhibits.how_drawn: twelve topics as a plain left-aligned list of white lines with no bullets, under a small underlined Not Exhaustive tag, beside a large cut-out photograph of a meeting table on the right
exhibits.marks: nothing is marked: the topics carry equal weight and the photograph sets the scene

exhibits.what: an iceberg drawing in bands, a row of icons with their labels beside each band
exhibits.message: Models are the tip of what generative AI value needs
exhibits.how_drawn: an iceberg drawn in five horizontal bands from white through light and mid blues to grey below a wavy water line, with five round icons down the right, each beside a sentence whose lead words are in bright blue
exhibits.marks: the bright blue lead words name each layer, and the water line splits the visible model from the four layers under it

exhibits.what: three icons in a row, each over a name and a description of one approach
exhibits.message: Companies can take, shape or make generative AI solutions
exhibits.how_drawn: three white circles each holding a dark line icon, over a bold serif name and a thin rule, with three to five lines of white description under it; a ribbon of blue sine waves runs along the foot
exhibits.marks: nothing is marked: the three approaches are set side by side with equal weight

exhibits.what: a numbered list of six questions, each led by a bold phrase
exhibits.message: Six questions decide whether a board executes on generative AI
exhibits.how_drawn: a white panel on the left holds the serif heading and a short line under it; on the dark right a numbered list of six questions, each led by a bold white phrase and a colon
exhibits.marks: the numbers 1 to 6 order the questions and the bold lead phrase names each one

exhibits.what: a grid of big figures, two rows of boards against four survey measures, the last column boxed
exhibits.message: Highly effective boards outscore less effective ones on every measure
exhibits.how_drawn: a grid of big serif figures in bright blue, two rows of boards with a ring icon and a bold label on the left against four survey measures, each column captioned in white under its first figure
exhibits.marks: a thin white rectangle encloses the induction training column, 24% against 43%, and its italic note says detail follows on page 15

exhibits.what: a claim on the left beside a list of statements on a dark panel, the last set apart in bold
exhibits.message: Boards take on more but keep directors without the new skills
exhibits.how_drawn: a white panel on the left holds a bold serif claim between two thin rules; on the dark right a short Boards heading, three plain lines, a rule and then the closing statement set apart in bold
exhibits.marks: the closing statement is set bold under its own rule, apart from the three lines above it, so the contrast reads last

exhibits.what: a ring in three segments around a label, each segment with its heading, quote and bullets
exhibits.message: An effective director combines know-how, skills and mindset
exhibits.how_drawn: a ring cut into three segments in white, light blue and mid blue around a dark centre labelled Effective Director, each segment with a numbered dot and its heading, quote and bullets set outside it
exhibits.marks: the numbered dots 1 to 3 tie each segment to its block of text; the segment colours are repeated in the headings

exhibits.what: a matrix of skills down the side against current and future directors, cells filled where present
exhibits.message: The current board lacks skills the strategy needs
exhibits.how_drawn: a grid of small cells, skills down the side grouped under three rotated labels, directors across in two groups, white cells for gaps and dark cells with a white check where a director has the skill; process steps in a column on the left behind a circled arrow
exhibits.marks: check marks fill the cells where a director has the skill, the white cells show the gaps the small key names, and a blue outline encloses the three directors to be replaced

exhibits.what: a table of session kinds down the side, a description and sample topics across
exhibits.message: Onboarding runs through four kinds of session
exhibits.how_drawn: a text table without cell lines: four session kinds in a column, a description column with the first set in bright blue, and a sample topics column split by thin rules, bold phrases inside the sentences
exhibits.marks: the first session kind and its description are set in bright blue and a bracket line ties them to the sample topics; key phrases are bold

exhibits.what: a dense three-row table, one row each for know-how, skills and mindset, with bolded phrases
exhibits.message: The ideal director's know-how, skills and mindset in detail
exhibits.how_drawn: three rows split by thin rules: a bright blue label and a white quote on the left, dense lines of white text on the right with key phrases in bold and some lines bulleted
exhibits.marks: the bold phrase leading each line names its point; the bright blue labels name the three rows, and nothing is drawn over the text

source_line: on every page whose exhibits include a data_chart or a table: true or false, read off the page; null elsewhere
